Background: Tenergy Model 34404 is the original, custom designed battery pack for the Puskas / MrsPottsV2 / AirDial appliance, developed by Tenergy under the guidance of Ooma HW Engineering over a period of several months. - Tenergy 34404 meets required electrical specifications.  Much work and resources were put into its development and qualification. - Ooma funded the UL 2054+UL/CSA 62368 investigation and testing, achieving authorization to apply the UL Mark per UL File MH47256.  - Operations added a second source battery pack from HuiLiLanHai.  This second source is based on the Tenergy 34404 design, nearly a direct copy. - Operations managed safety testing of the (battery pack+AirDial enclosure.)  It is reported that MET Labs Laboratories claims a mylar wrap around the battery pack is required due to the design of the plastic enclosure around the battery areas, and that Tenergy "refused to update their spec to add the mylar." - Engineering suspects MET Labs may have misinterpreted the safety requirements and applicability of a need for additional mylar wrap, but this has not been pursued.
